drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 77-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.41, bnp 2131, creatinine 2.11, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 304, sodium 140, wbc 5.5; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 78-81, map 88-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 118-125, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 34%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.11, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 298, sodium 140, wbc 5.8; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 79-84, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 119-125, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 77-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute systolic heart failure. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
